Definition: Talmai, the name of a Canaanite and a Syrian
BiblicalUsage: Talmai = "furrowed"; 1) one of the 3 sons of the giant Anak who were slain by the men of Judah; 2) son of Ammihud, king of Geshur, later king of Geshur himself, and father of Maacah, the mother of Absalom and wife of David
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
